shortDescription: The Czech government approved on Monday a 2,500 crown, or 11.2%, increase in the minimum gross monthly wage to 24,900 crowns, ($1,195.91) effective from January 2027, news agency CTK reported.The increase will put minimum wage at 44.6% of the average wage, it said.($1 = 20.8210 Czech crowns)

children: The Czech government approved on Monday a 2,500 crown, or 11.2%, increase in the minimum gross monthly wage to 24,900 crowns, ($1,195.91) effective from January 2027, news agency CTK reported.
The increase will put minimum wage at 44.6% of the average wage, it said.
